title: Bengaluru Metro Yellow Line Crosses One Lakh Daily Riders
summary: The Yellow Line connecting RV Road and Bommasandra hit a new daily ridership record as office commuters shift from road to rail.
content: The Yellow Line recorded over one lakh passengers in a single day for the first time this week. Metro officials attributed the jump to increased train frequency during peak hours and new feeder bus routes around Electronic City. Commuters reported travel times between Silk Board and Electronic City dropping from nearly an hour by road to under twenty minutes. Officials said additional train sets are expected by early next year.

title: Popular Open-Source Container Runtime Ships Version 3.0
summary: The release brings faster image pulls, rootless mode by default and a smaller memory footprint for edge devices.
content: Maintainers announced version 3.0 of the runtime with rootless containers enabled by default, lazy image pulling that starts containers before all layers finish downloading, and a 30 percent reduction in idle memory usage. Several cloud providers said they would roll out support over the coming quarter. Users upgrading from 2.x are advised to review the migration guide for changes to the configuration format.

title: Indian Startups Raise $3.2 Billion in Q3, Fintech Leads
summary: Funding rebounded for the second straight quarter, with fintech and climate tech drawing the largest rounds.
content: A quarterly report on venture activity shows startups in India raised $3.2 billion across 290 deals in the July to September period. Fintech accounted for nearly a third of the total, followed by climate tech and enterprise software. Early-stage deal counts rose, though average cheque sizes remained below the 2021 peak. Analysts expect the momentum to continue into the festive quarter.

title: India Clinch ODI Series With Last-Over Win
summary: A composed finish from the lower order sealed a 2-1 series victory in a tense decider.
content: Chasing 287, India needed nine runs off the final over and got there with one ball to spare. The middle order steadied the innings after an early collapse, and a late partnership of 54 runs swung the match. The captain praised the team's calm under pressure and said the series win was valuable preparation for upcoming tournaments.

title: Northeast Monsoon Expected Over Tamil Nadu and Karnataka This Week
summary: Forecasters say the southwest monsoon has withdrawn, with northeast monsoon rains likely to begin within days.
content: The weather department said conditions are favourable for the onset of the northeast monsoon over coastal Tamil Nadu, south interior Karnataka and parts of Andhra Pradesh. Moderate to heavy rainfall is forecast in several districts over the weekend. Residents in low-lying areas have been advised to stay alert for waterlogging.

title: Regular Sleep Timing Linked to Better Heart Health, Study Finds
summary: Researchers found that consistent bedtimes mattered as much as total sleep duration for cardiovascular outcomes.
content: A multi-year study following over 60,000 adults found that people with the most irregular sleep schedules had a higher risk of cardiovascular events, even when they slept the recommended number of hours. Researchers suggested keeping bedtime and wake time within a 30-minute window. They noted the study shows an association and further trials are needed to establish cause.

title: Space Agency Completes Lander Drop Tests for Next Lunar Mission
summary: Engineers validated the lander's upgraded legs and hazard-avoidance cameras in a series of integrated tests.
content: The space agency said the lander for its next lunar mission successfully completed drop and hazard-detection tests at its integration facility. The upgraded landing legs are designed to tolerate higher touchdown speeds, and new cameras improve the selection of safe landing spots. The mission is targeted for launch next year, pending final reviews.

title: City Film Festival Announces 120-Film Lineup
summary: This year's edition features a regional cinema spotlight, restored classics and a short-film competition for students.
content: Organisers unveiled a lineup of 120 films from 40 countries for the annual festival, which runs for eight days next month across five venues. A dedicated section will showcase restored regional classics, and a new student short-film competition received over 600 entries. Passes go on sale online next week.

title: Central Bank Holds Key Rate Steady, Signals Watchful Stance
summary: The monetary policy committee kept the repo rate unchanged, citing stable inflation and steady growth.
content: The monetary policy committee voted to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at its October meeting. The governor said inflation remained within the target band and growth indicators were resilient, but global uncertainty warranted caution. Markets had largely expected the decision, and bond yields moved little after the announcement.

title: Demand for Kubernetes Skills Up 40% in Indian Job Listings
summary: Hiring data shows cloud-native and platform engineering roles are among the fastest-growing in tech.
content: An analysis of tech job postings found that listings mentioning Kubernetes rose 40 percent year over year, with Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Pune accounting for most openings. Platform engineering and site reliability roles saw the sharpest growth. Recruiters said candidates who can show hands-on experience deploying containerised services are getting multiple offers.
